    # identify the longest connected straight run of 1s (the directional ray)
    runs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
        if len(cs)>=2: runs.append((len(cs),'h',r,cs))
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==1]
        if len(rs)>=2: runs.append((len(rs),'v',c,rs))
    if not runs: return out
    _,axis,fixed,vals=max(runs)
    if axis=='v':

            c=lo-1 if direction<0 else hi+1
            while 0<=c<w and grid[r][c] != 3:
                if grid[r][c]==4: out[r][c]=1
                c+=direction
    return out

                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
